Plain-Node daemon smoke executes a built real process and hard-checks readiness, ownership, RPC shutdown, cleanup, and endpoint disappearance. PTY health remains explicitly advisory.

embedded_checks.reason: PID, launch nonce, entry path and app version are checked against the launched daemon.

embedded_checks.reason: Actual canonical socket/named-pipe publication must be observable.

embedded_checks.reason: A deliberately retained dead inode is allowed, but a connected endpoint is rejected.

advisory_checks.reason: Best-effort diagnostic; failures are explicitly logged as skips and never satisfy a hard PTY delivery assertion.

rationale: Real Unix daemon races and a forced live-incumbent phase protect endpoint ownership. Windows intentionally skips this Unix inode contract.

embedded_checks.reason: Actual racers replace the dead inode and exactly one token authenticates to the survivor.

embedded_checks.reason: A separate known-live phase requires refusal, exact adoption exit code, intact endpoint/reachability, and no newcomer ownership record.

execution_note: Classified and reviewed; standalone script not run in this batch.
